news.title: Sam Altman aims to 'help de-escalate' tensions with Pentagon as OpenAI employees voice support for Anthropic
news.description: Altman said OpenAI shares Anthropic's red lines when it comes to use of its models, according to a memo he shared with employees.

news.title: Core wholesale prices rose 0.8% in January, much more than expected
news.description: The core producer price index increased a seasonally adjusted 0.8%, more than the 0.6% gain in December.

news.title: UBS downgrades the U.S. stock market. Here's what has the investment bank worried
news.description: UBS downgraded U.S. equities to "benchmark" in a fully invested global equity portfolio, saying factors that powered years of outperformance are starting to fade.
